name: stream-recognizer
description: Standalone radio stream song recognition (Shazam; pluggable providers)

scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-loader newrelic/esm-loader.mjs -r newrelic --experimental-specifier-resolution=node' node --env-file=.env src/index.js
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development PINO_LOG_LEVEL=debug NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-loader newrelic/esm-loader.mjs -r newrelic --experimental-specifier-resolution=node' node --env-file=.env src/index.js
